name: x265-butler
description: x265-butler reclaims disk space on Unraid by automatically transcoding video files to HEVC (x265). Scans library shares for non-x265 files, transcodes them in the background using ffmpeg, tracks results in a dashboard, and never re-encodes the same file twice. Lighter-weight than Tdarr / FileFlows / Unmanic. Setup guide (install, updates, GPU): https://gitlab.com/MisterJB/x265-butler/-/blob/main/docs/user/README.md [!] Images moved to the GitLab registry with v2.54.0. Installs from before must change the Repository field to registry.gitlab.com/misterjb/x265-butler:latest to keep receiving updates; the old ghcr.io image stays at 2.53.0. Recent highlights: Stats + Dashboard / UI Redesign / Encoder-Benchmark with Pareto-Frontier / Encoder-Profile-Editor / Multi-Share / Storage-Analyzer / Auto-Scan-on-Change. Release notes for every version: https://gitlab.com/MisterJB/x265-butler/-/releases [!] Image tag: we strongly recommend keeping the :latest tag in the Repository field. Fixes only ship in new releases, older version tags are removed from the registry over time, and Unraid shows update notices only for :latest. Read the release notes before a major upgrade (v2.x to v3.x). A version tag (registry.gitlab.com/misterjb/x265-butler:X.Y.Z) is only a short way back to the previous release: back up your AppData folder first and switch back to :latest once a fix is out.

paths.name: Media
paths.description: Your media share. Butler scans it and writes the HEVC file into the same folder as the original, so it needs read and write access. Installs from an older template that use /library keep working unchanged.

paths.name: AppData
paths.description: Database, settings and a cache subfolder for encode scratch space and job logs. Called Config in versions before 2.52: same path, nothing to change. To put the cache on a fast pool, set Cache Pool below.

paths.name: Cache Pool (optional)
paths.description: Optional. Leave empty to keep the cache inside AppData. Point it at a fast SSD pool, e.g. /mnt/cache/x265-butler.

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: HTTP port for the x265-butler dashboard

variables.name: NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES
variables.description: Optional, for NVENC only. Set to all (or a GPU UUID) and add --runtime=nvidia under Extra Parameters. Leave empty without an NVIDIA GPU.

variables.name: NVIDIA_DRIVER_CAPABILITIES
variables.description: For NVENC only. Keep compute,video,utility; without video every NVENC encode fails. Ignored without --runtime=nvidia.
